title: Fix permanent issue.* refusal on malformed SPEC bodies
progress_summary: Root cause proven: header-present-but-malformed SPEC bodies made Cache::load_entry return None, so receipt renewal always failed and issue.view/edit/comment refused forever (#4388, #4390). Fix: load_entry surfaces them with spec_parse_error; write_section refuses them; issue.edit accepts the body repair. RED tests written and failing as expected; GREEN runs in progress.
